explanation: Fires on a short function word that opens a phrase whose content head is still to come: a preposition after a predicate or noun (in, on, per, dans, de, au, entre, pour, avec), an article or determiner (a, un, la, delle) or an auxiliary or 'having' that takes a complement (has, have, having, essere, être). Activation stays elevated on any pre-head modifier (' large', ' small', ' multiple') and drops to near zero once the head noun or main verb arrives (' bag', ' Europe', ' glass', ' supermarché'); content words outside such an open phrase, and sentence-final punctuation, are predicted inactive.
